question: What information was received from Ireland, presumably under Article 1(3) or Article 4 of Directive 2011/92/EU1, in 2022 to justify the non-application of this directive to projects whose purpose was to provide accommodation for applicants for international protection in Ireland?

Directive 2011/92/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 December 2011 on the assessment of the effects of certain public and private projects on the environment, OJ L 26, 28.1.2012, p. 1, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/dir/2011/92/oj.
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (23.1.2025) Articles 1(3) and 4 of the Environmental Impact Assessment Directive1 do not provide any reporting obligations by Member States to the Commission. As a result, in 2022 no information was received on the non-application of the Directive to the projects referred to in the written question.
1 Directive 2011/92/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 December 2011 on the assessment

of the effects of certain public and private projects on the environment, OJ L 26, 28.1.2012, p. 1–21, as amended by Directive 2014/52/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 16 April 2014, OJ L 124, 25.4.2014, p. 1–18.
